title: Guard mesh shader against empty/partial workgroups and out-of-range outputs
purpose: Prevent undefined behavior when the last workgroup has fewer than local_size_x particles, which can lead to silent failures.

steps.detail: In shaders/particle_mesh.mesh, compute particlesInWorkgroup = min(local_size_x, max(0, pc.particleCount - gl_WorkGroupID.x * gl_WorkGroupSize.x)). If particlesInWorkgroup==0, SetMeshOutputsEXT(0,0) and return.
For threads with particleIndex >= pc.particleCount, return before writing to gl_MeshVerticesEXT or gl_PrimitiveTriangleIndicesEXT.
When writing vertices/indices, wrap in if(particleIndex < pc.particleCount) to avoid out-of-range writes in the last partial group.

acceptance: App no longer freezes within ~1s; stable for 30+ seconds
No GPU hangs; no validation complaints about out-of-bounds mesh output
